subject: Pilot proposal & access checklist — Clarify Health
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Doyle <mdoyle@clarifyhealth.com>, Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@clarifyhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot proposal & access checklist — Clarify Health

Hi Michael / Sarah —

Thanks again for a productive conversation today. Quick recap and a proposed pilot plan to keep momentum: 

Highlights we heard (confirm if any of this is off):
- Pain: high false positives in claims routing and significant manual triage (current ML model ~72% precision).
- Goal: reduce manual review by 30% and surface high-confidence routing suggestions without increasing downstream errors.
- Data: Clarify can provide a rolling sample of 10k de-identified claims + labeling for ~2k review examples.
- Security: PHI concerns — your security team prefers a private deployment or a VPC-hosted Dedicated cluster (we noted SOC 2 docs requested).

Proposed 3-week pilot (outline):
1) Scope: ingest 10k records (de-identified), run model ops on 5 canonical routing flows, validate predictions against your label set.
2) Success metrics: precision at top-1, reduction in manual-review volume (baseline -> target -30%), avg inference p95 latency <= 250ms.
3) Eval: prompt set + automated eval harness (we'll run batch and streaming scenarios).
4) Owners: Clarify will own data extraction and labeling; Redwood will run serving, prompt/eval setup, and weekly checkpoints.
5) Timeline: kickoff early next week (Mon 2026-05-11) -> 3 weeks -> final readout by 2026-06-01.
6) Access/ops asks (what we need from Clarify to start):
   - S3 link or secure transfer of sample dataset + schema (CSV/NDJSON),
   - service account or SSH for SFTP + the contact for your security reviewer,
   - a sample set of labels (at least 2k) and a short description of your decision rules.

I've attached a one-page pilot charter (clarify_pilot_charter_draft.pdf) and a sample prompt set (sample_prompt_set.csv) — these are drafts we can iterate on.

Next steps / asks from you:
- Confirm the proposed scope and kickoff date (Mon 2026-05-11)
- Share the dataset access method and security contact (we can accept a short non-prod dataset to start)
- If procurement needs pricing/term details, loop them in and we'll send a one-page commercial summary.

I'll book a 30-min kickoff for Mon if that date works.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0198

Attachments: clarify_pilot_charter_draft.pdf (pilot charter, 2 pages); sample_prompt_set.csv (prompt examples and eval checks); soc2-screenshots.png (SOC2 self-attestation snippet)

Subject: Re: Pilot proposal & access checklist — Clarify Health

Priya —

Appreciate the clear plan and the materials. Confirming the high-level items look right to us. A few follow-ups from our side: 

1) Security / deployment: our security lead (cc'd) prefers a Dedicated / VPC-hosted deployment for the pilot because of PHI risk. Can you include a short comparison of Dedicated vs Private deployment during kickoff? We need to understand the time/cost impact.
2) Pricing / procurement: procurement@clarifyhealth.com is on copy — they asked for a one-page cost estimate (3-week pilot + 1 engineer-day support) and standard MSA/terms to speed review.
3) Data delivery: we'll prepare a de-identified extract and share via SFTP. ETA for SFTP credentials: end of day Monday (2026-05-10).

We confirm kickoff on Mon 2026-05-11 at 10:00am PT if that still works. Please send a calendar invite and the agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

-Michael
Michael Doyle
Senior Product Manager, Data Ops | Clarify Health
mdoyle@clarifyhealth.com | +1 617 555 0123
